uiQualityFindings: The landing page lacks visual hierarchy and design polish. Key sections are present
but the layout and responsiveness need improvement for a better user experience.
The component is functional, but lacks prop types or TypeScript integration for better type safety.
The CSS is clean, but the hero section could use more semantic HTML elements. Flex properties are used correctly.
The structure is maintainable, but will benefit from breaking the App component into smaller, reusable components.
Header and sections are not using appropriate semantic HTML structures; HTML roles and aria-labels are missing.
The media queries are present but the layout could be tested across various screen resolutions for better adaptability.
Use of semantic tags is not fully adhered to; consider using nav, main, and section elements effectively.
The design feels somewhat generic and can be enhanced with more engaging visuals and interactive elements.
Navigation works, but it could use clearer call-to-action buttons and possibly a sticky navigation for better accessibility.
Some responsiveness is implemented, but overall, cross-device testing needed to ensure all elements scale correctly.
